payload.summary: MAR-2921: the operation lock is the BEGIN IMMEDIATE transaction on operation-lock.sqlite plus the short-lived operation-lock.recovery marker; the operation.lock directory, its candidates and candidate maintenance are removed.
rationale: The SQLite gate was already authoritative and the operating system releases it when a holder exits; the directory lock duplicated it.
The recovery marker is kept because every gate opener takes it briefly, which is what makes automatic replacement of a corrupt gate safe (see review.lock-corrupt-gate-recovery).
rules: 0.3.0 and 0.4.0 also take the same gate, so upgraded and older processes still exclude each other.
After acquiring the gate, a stable leftover operation.lock directory from an earlier release is quarantined; one that changes during observation is ignored rather than failing the operation.
Leftover operation.lock.<uuid> candidates from earlier releases are inert and are not enumerated.
